Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev

Class CustomCardsRest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.BasicRestServlet
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.CustomCardsRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class CustomCardsRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
The Custom cards page, which shows how an adopter writes a card type, and the feeds its cards read.

The page has a JSON-only card type (kpi), a Java-validated one (inventory-gauge, see InventoryGaugeCardType) and two charts: the stock bands and the zoomable prices.

Both JS handlers live in petstore-cards.js, served beside this class, which also shows the card API (JuneauConsole.refreshCard, JuneauConsole.cardApi) and the juneau:card-mounted event.

Example:

(window.JuneauConsoleCards = window.JuneauConsoleCards || []).push(['kpi', { render(card, el, ctx) { ... } }]);

GET /console/dev/cards the page GET /console/dev/cards/stats/available {label, value} for the kpi card GET /console/dev/cards/inventory?species= {species, available, pending, sold} for the gauge GET /console/dev/cards/inventory/all one gauge row per species, for the stock bands chart GET /console/dev/cards/prices {id, price} per pet, for the prices chart GET /console/dev/cards/petstore-cards.js the page script
